0022600092.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Suns on the road in Portland. Phoenix is without Luke Kennard, who is out with a knee strain, and Mark Williams, who is out after shoulder surgery, while Portland is missing Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery). The Suns won the 2025-26 series 2-1, but their most recent meeting was a 92-77 loss to Portland in Phoenix on February 22, 2026.
